address: Kuşçular Mahallesi, 8018/1. Sokak No:39, Urla, Izmir, 35437, Türkiye

tags.name: Pets allowed only in outdoor dining areas (patio/terrace)

bio: The terrace of this inviting restaurant is the best place to experience the charm of the Hus wine estate to the full. The sight of the vines and olive trees immediately has a calming effect. Be sure to sample the wines produced on site – your charming service team is on hand to offer expert guidance. These wines pair perfectly with the food, which is a contemporary take on Mediterranean cuisine prepared to order. Having started with the addictive house-made focaccia, for example, you could move on to the perfectly cooked medium-rare lamb saddle seasoned with rosemary, accompanied by a robust lamb jus and a roasted garlic cream to really bring out the characteristic flavour of the meat. Finish off with a Turkish coffee for a burst of intensity!
